summary: Keep reconciliation controls responsive while runtime starts are blocked

replay.detail: Existing graph projections require no replay. Opening the upgraded local store creates an empty launch-operation ledger; subsequent launches retain immutable request and result bindings. Unresolved operations survive daemon restarts and are never automatically replayed.

schema.detail: Local SQLite storage advances from 18 to 19, adding runtime-start operation and evidence tables plus admission indexes. Both stores use one shared storage-version constant. Unresolved local request/result evidence is pinned against trimming. Existing version-18 stores migrate additively on open; older binaries reject version 19. Resolved ledger rows are retained, including their prepared launch body; disk usage currently grows with launch count and requires capacity planning until a separate reviewed retention policy is added.

rules.detail: Replicated claim kinds, checkpoint rules and rule digests are unchanged; the operation ledger is local state.

compatibility.detail: Agent detail responses add pending-operation, running/revoked-running and unresolved/revoked-unresolved fields; agents show displays START, START JOBS and START OPEN. Native exec generation records retain an optional launch-operation identifier. Existing PTY tags carry the operation. Strict prevention of late PTY publication remains unresolved and requires a coordinated producer contract; this slice performs exact-operation, incarnation-fenced cleanup when a late runtime is observed. Returned launches with missing or mismatched operation/incarnation evidence remain Unknown and retain admission until exact verification or positive producer closure. Native rejection before producer or child creation carries exact-operation closure evidence; errors after creation are not interpreted as closure.

downtime.detail: Normal deployment still requires daemon restart. The additive local migration has fixture coverage, but restart-to-API and restart-to-health times have not been measured on installation-sized stores.

manual.detail: Inspect START OPEN after upgrade when a start was interrupted or revoked. Ordinary launch failure or absent runtime observation does not prove producer closure, so an uncertain operation retains admission and its evidence until exact closure or operation-owned retirement is verified. Do not clear the ledger to force a retry. See docs/seat-lifecycle.md.

recovery.detail: Roll forward with the version-19 store preserved. Swap-back requires verified closure of pending producers and operation-owned runtimes, preservation of the upgraded ledger for investigation, and restoration of a consistent pre-upgrade database with its compatible binary. Reinstalling an older binary or downgrading the storage header does not undo the migration. Operations must review this procedure before rollout.
